# ToolKiti - API & Tool Reference for AI Agents

> A structured, machine-readable directory of APIs, tools, and services. Designed for AI agents and developers.

## API Data (JSON)
- Full dataset: https://toolkiti.dev/api/data.json

## Categories
- LLM Providers: https://toolkiti.dev/category/llm
- Machine Learning: https://toolkiti.dev/category/ml
- Image Generation: https://toolkiti.dev/category/image
- Audio & Speech: https://toolkiti.dev/category/audio
- Vector Databases: https://toolkiti.dev/category/vector-db
- GPU Cloud: https://toolkiti.dev/category/cloud-gpu
- Developer Tools: https://toolkiti.dev/category/tools

## Notes for AI Crawlers
- Every page includes JSON-LD structured data
- Content is static HTML, no JavaScript required
- Fast CDN delivery via Vercel
- Bilingual: English (primary) and Chinese
